title.zh: Nobel Prize in Physics goes to Francis Halzen
title.en: Nobel Prize in Physics goes to Francis Halzen

current_state.zh: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Francis Halzen for conceiving the IceCube neutrino detector, a cubic-kilometer sensor array built in the Antarctic ice that detects neutrinos via Cherenkov radiation.
current_state.en: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Francis Halzen for conceiving the IceCube neutrino detector, a cubic-kilometer sensor array built in the Antarctic ice that detects neutrinos via Cherenkov radiation.
